name: component-catalog-screenshots
goal: Show visual component screenshots bound to the selected revision, retaining validated capture origins and explicit gaps.

evidence: Visual component catalogs need screenshots from the shown revision. Valid unchanged captures must name their original commit; invalid or missing captures remain gaps. Reuse the existing page card.

The standardized catalog checks required text tables and never asserted component images. Extend their existing SSR and browser cases with fresh, inherited, missing, rejected and branch-switching evidence at all three viewports.
